primitives.summary: A block of text. Animate it with enter, exit and tracks.

text.label: Text. Use \n for a line break.

primitives.summary: A plain rectangle: a card, a rule, a colour field.

fill.label: Surface name (base, surface, sunken, accent, inverse) or a CSS colour

primitives.summary: A picture. The path is relative to the film file.
Static markup, for content no primitive covers. Style it with --ui-* tokens.
An empty frame the host page fills, e.g. with a rendered bydiorama/ui component.
Words rise and fade in one by one.

accent.label: Words set in the accent colour

primitives.summary: Characters appear one by one with a caret.
Characters cycle randomly before settling.
A number rolls up to its value.
Items appear one after another.
A floating collage on several depth planes.

speed.label: Drift speed of the nearest plane

primitives.summary: Rows of chips or logos scrolling sideways.

highlight.label: One label to emphasise while the others dim

dim_opacity.label: Opacity of the other items once one is emphasised

primitives.summary: Tiles on a tilted ring that rotates forever.

items.label: Tile labels. Repeated to fill the ring; empty tiles when left out.

primitives.summary: Squares or dots sized by a gradient.

edge.label: Edge the field grows from: top or bottom

reach.label: How far into the frame it reaches

primitives.summary: Lines or words slide up from under an edge, one after another.

text.label: The text. Use \n to set the line breaks yourself.

accent.label: Words set in the accent colour

tilt.label: Tilt that settles as it rises

primitives.summary: Letters arrive one by one: rising, turning, growing or coming into focus.

accent.label: Words set in the accent colour

primitives.summary: A solid block covers each line, then retracts as the line slides out from behind it.

text.label: The text. Use \n to set the line breaks

accent.label: Words set in the accent colour

fill.label: Block colour: accent, inverse, primary or a CSS colour

duration.label: Time for one block to grow and retract

primitives.summary: Words roll vertically in a slot.

words.label: Words that take turns in the slot; the last one stays

roll.label: Time to roll to the next

primitives.summary: Wide-spaced letters close up to their set spacing while coming into focus.
A band of light passes across the letters, again and again.

strength.label: How dim the text is outside the band

primitives.summary: Copies of a headline trail behind it.

settle.label: Gap between copies at rest (0 hides them under the headline)

primitives.summary: A hand-drawn mark draws under or around a word.

mark.label: Words to mark (a run of words gets one mark)

primitives.summary: Each digit rolls in its own column and lands on the value.

duration.label: Time for the last column to land

stagger.label: Delay between columns, right to left

spins.label: Extra turns per column to its right

primitives.summary: Lines draw themselves along their paths, then the shapes fill.

paths.label: SVG path data, one path per item, drawn in order

viewbox.label: SVG viewBox the paths are drawn in

fill.label: Fill once drawn: none, accent, primary or a CSS colour

fill_time.label: Time for the fill to arrive

primitives.summary: One shape grows in, then turns into the next, and the next.

shapes.label: Shapes in order: circle, square, squircle, triangle, diamond, hexagon, star, pill, plus, blob

fill.label: accent, primary, surface, inverse, outline or a CSS colour

morph.label: Time to turn into the next

primitives.summary: A field of dots or tiles appears in a wave from one point, then keeps breathing.

pulse.label: How much the field keeps breathing afterwards

primitives.summary: The mark lands, then moves aside as the name slides out from behind it.

name.label: Wordmark text. Left out, the mark lands alone

tagline.label: One short line under the lockup

mark_path.label: SVG path data of the mark. Left out, a shape is used

mark_shape.label: Shape used when there is no mark_path

arrive.label: Time for the mark to land

slide.label: Time for the name to slide out

mark_size.label: Mark height, relative to the name

primitives.summary: Bars grow from the baseline one after another, each value counting up with it.

labels.label: Bar labels, in the same order

highlight.label: Label of the one bar set in the accent

grow.label: Time for one bar to grow

primitives.summary: A line draws left to right behind a leading dot, the area fills, the last value lands.

labels.label: Labels under the first and last points (two items), or one per point

decimals.label: Decimal places of the end value

primitives.summary: Soft fields of colour drift and blend behind the content, looping without a seam.

colors.label: CSS colours of the fields. Left out, shades of the accent

primitives.summary: Fine film grain over the frame, changing a set number of times a second.
A drawn cursor moves to a target and clicks.

label.label: A name tag beside the cursor, for a collaborator

transitions.summary: A plain cut placed on a music beat.
One scene blurs out while the next blurs in.

overlap.label: Share of the time both scenes are visible

transitions.summary: Stepped bars sweep across the frame.
The next scene pushes the current one out of frame, with parallax and motion blur.

parallax.label: How much less the outgoing scene travels

blur.label: Motion blur at full speed (1 = a half-frame shutter)

transitions.summary: The next scene opens from a point in a growing circle.

push_in.label: How much the outgoing scene pushes in

transitions.summary: Colour panels sweep across and cover the cut, then sweep on to uncover the next scene.

lag.label: How far each panel trails the one before

transitions.summary: The camera pushes into a point until it fills the frame.

scale_to.label: How far the camera pushes in

axis.label: Panels meet along a vertical or a horizontal line

transitions.summary: The next scene slides over the current one, which recedes and dims beneath it.

direction.label: Which way the new scene travels

recede.label: Scale the old scene shrinks to

dim.label: Brightness the old scene dims to

transitions.summary: A slanted edge cuts across the frame, uncovering the next scene; the old one drifts back.

drift.label: How far the old scene drifts
